name: Rama
note: Fan work, after Arthur C. Clarke's Rendezvous with Rama (1973). Nothing from any edition, cover, film design or game is used; every shape on this page is this project's own geometry, built to the numbers the novel gives. Rama lies along x, its north pole (the hub, the bow) to +x. Built by src/rama/ on the starship page (src/starship/page.js); 'rama' holds its numbers in metres.
attribution: Rama is fan work after Arthur C. Clarke's Rendezvous with Rama: original geometry in src/rama/. No assets used.

rama._: metres: plainR is the floor of the Northern Plain (gravity 0.6 g at four minutes a turn); the sea's surface lies 50 m below it (the northern cliff) and the Southern Plain 500 m above the sea (the southern cliff); plainEnd is where the plains meet the bowls, bowlDepth how far each bowl reaches toward its pole; period is one turn in seconds
